_comment: Aggregators-only variant: natural-language question sent to Parallel with source_policy.include_domains restricted to the curated free legal aggregators (CourtListener, Justia, Google Scholar, OpenJurist, caselaw.findlaw.com). No per-row court-specific domain scoping — every row sends the identical aggregator list, so no court-url-map is required and the adapter is trivially portable. Measures how Parallel performs against public case law when the search is restricted to open aggregators.
objective: Retrieve U.S. case law opinions relevant to the search query.

pricing.notes: Pricing not published on the Search API reference page as of the source_accessed_at date. Contact Parallel for current pricing.
